test_case.test_name: Parameterized authenticated AMD driver downgrade with separately gated AGFHC Level-5 validation
test_case.purpose: Downgrade from the recorded current AMD stack to the explicitly approved older version, prove that older stack loads on all expected GPUs, and run prescribed Level-5 health only under separate authorization.
required_package: Signed current and approved older AMD/ROCm artifacts, checksums, versions and security exception
OS/kernel/firmware/dependency compatibility matrix and exact vendor downgrade procedure
Approved reboot/OOB and tested recovery to the original current stack
Pinned AGFHC Level-5 artifact/config/spec, duration, thermal/power and abort limits
test_case.test_command: After artifact, exception, compatibility and recovery approval, capture the current stack and BDF bindings; execute the complete vendor downgrade with full logs, perform only the approved reboot, and prove the older packages/modules bind all expected GPUs. If separately authorized, run the exact Level-5 diagnostic and retain its full oracle; it does not prove package provenance.
test_case.expected_result: The authenticated older version replaces the current stack without unresolved transaction or compatibility error, loads across all expected BDFs, and any separately approved Level-5 run meets its exact health/thermal/power oracle.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete downgrade artifact/transaction evidence and loaded per-BDF post-state; if Level-5 is required, its separately approved full result must also pass. Truncated logs or diagnostics alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Explicit change and security approval are mandatory before removing the working stack.
Verify older package compatibility, OOB access and recovery artifact before change.
Level-5 sustained diagnostics require independent load/cooling/power approval.
Abort on dependency damage, partial transaction, boot/module/BDF loss, thermal/power/XID fault or lost access; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Source Key/Variant ID and separate standalone Level-5 identity
Signed older artifact, security exception, compatibility and exact approved command
Complete uninstall/install transaction, reboot identity and loaded versions
If authorized: Level-5 config/full log, thermal/power trace, result and cross-reference
test_case.recovery: On downgrade or diagnostic failure, preserve all transaction/boot/BDF/health evidence, stop load, and restore only the pre-approved original current stack via OOB. Revalidate every GPU and service; do not repeat automatically.
